# Frontend Select

Use only the rules that apply to the current consumer task.

- [Accessible combobox and multiselect](#accessible-combobox-and-multiselect)

## Accessible combobox and multiselect

Choose values with nh-combobox and nh-multiselect of @newheap/platform-select as form controls, with server search, create and translated texts registered once at the root.

## Preferred approach

Install `@newheap/platform-select` (Angular 20.3.28 through 22; its only peers
are Angular and rxjs) and import the standalone `NhComboboxComponent` for one
value or `NhMultiselectComponent` for several. Bind them as form controls
(`formControl`, `formControlName` or `ngModel`), or with `[value]` and
`(valueChange)` outside a form. Pass options as `NhSelectOption<T>`: `value`,
`label` and optionally `description`, `disabled`, `icon` (icon-library
classes), `image` and `classes`. Name the field with a `<label for>` that
matches `inputId`, or with `ariaLabel`, and point `describedBy` at its hint
and error message; set `invalid` while the control is invalid.

```html
<label for="owner">Owner</label>
<nh-combobox
  inputId="owner"
  formControlName="ownerId"
  describedBy="owner-hint"
  [search]="searchPeople"
  [selectedLabel]="project.ownerName"
  [errorText]="searchError" />
```

- A value the form writes is never reported back as a change, so the form
  stays pristine until the person chooses; leaving the field marks it touched,
  and the disabled state follows the form.
- Every primitive value is kept, including `0`, `false` and `''`. Pass
  `compareWith` for object values.
- `noneLabel` adds an explicit empty choice that stands for `noneValue`
  (default `null`). Use it for optional single values; there is no separate
  clear button.
- For server data pass `search`, a function that answers an `Observable` or a
  `Promise` of options for the typed text. It runs after `minQueryLength`
  characters (default 2; `0` searches when the list opens) and a pause of
  `searchDebounceMs` (default 250); an answer to an older text is ignored.
  Keep filtering and paging on the server, for example with the collection
  `search` of `NhApiService.getCollection`. Show stored values that the options
  do not contain with `selectedLabel` or `selectedOptions`.
- Map a failed search to a localized, actionable text with `errorText`; the
  field shows it with a Try again button instead of "nothing found".
- `create` offers a "Create" row for text that equals no option's label and
  chooses the option it answers. Add that option to your options in
  `optionCreated` when it should stay in the list.
- A multiselect shows chips; Enter or a click adds or removes an option and
  keeps the list open, Backspace in the empty search removes the last chip, and
  a chosen disabled option is locked.

Register application-wide texts once at the root with `provideNhSelect`. Pass a
factory that reads the application's translation service and answers a signal
of `NhSelectConfig`, so `NhSelectTexts` follow a language change. Per-control
`texts` win over the root texts.

Theme the controls with the `--nh-select-*` custom properties on the
application's design tokens, as the sample does in its `styles.scss`; light and
dark defaults, `size="compact"` and reduced motion are built in.

## Legacy alternative

`nh-form-dropdown` of `@newheap/platform-common` remains supported for existing
forms. Keep a migration of such a form deliberate: the values, the emitted
events and the lazy-load settings differ.

## Avoid

- Wrapping the control in a component that reports written values back
  through `onChange`; that makes a form dirty without a choice.
- Filtering a large server collection in the browser instead of `search`.
- Showing raw server responses or stack traces from a failed search; return a
  translated text from `errorText`.
- Handling Escape around the control yourself: an open list marks Escape as
  handled, so a surrounding `NhModal` stays open, and a closed list leaves it
  to the modal.
- Hand-written chevrons, chips or checkboxes around the control.

## Verification

The focused specs `nh-combobox.component.spec.ts` and
`nh-multiselect.component.spec.ts` of `nh-select` cover the keyboard, the
form-control contract without echo, `0` and `false`, server search with its
loading, empty and error states and retry, create, chips, `OnPush` hosts and
the disabled state. In the sample's platform lab, search a project by two
characters, switch on the unavailable search and try again, create a label,
remove a chip with Backspace and check that Set from code keeps the form
pristine. Compile packaged consumers on Angular 20, 21 and 22 with
`npm --prefix src/Front-end run nh-select:test:compatibility`.
